summary: West Bay BDC LLC filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its revolving credit facility with Standard Chartered Bank. The amendment increases the maximum commitment to $460 million and raises the applicable advance rate to 80%. This is a routine credit agreement modification, not a special situation. The registrant is a business development company adjusting its borrowing terms. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are present. What to watch: none, as this is purely a financing arrangement update.
